mia (engineering): quick benefit question  i moved from 1099 -> W2 on 2026-01-20 but my first FT paycheck didn't land until 2026-02-09. I also had an approved unpaid medical leave 2026-02-10 -> 2026-02-23. 1) Am I eligible for employer 401k match for contributions taken on 2/09 only, or can we backdate to the conversion effective date? 2) do employer contributions vest differently when hire was previously contractor? 3) my HSA contributions seem missing for the pay with unpaid leave can that be fixed?
sam (People Ops): congrats on joining full-time! short answers: 1) match is based on payroll status and actual employee deferrals. automatic match applies to deferrals on paychecks after you're on payroll as employee (so 2/09 deferrals should be matched). retroactive match to contractor pay generally not allowed unless payroll/vendor error; we can request an off-cycle if there's an exception. 2) vesting: employer contributions follow the standard vesting schedule in the plan doc (typically 2yr cliff or graded). previous contractor service doesn't automatically count toward vesting unless explicitly credited; we can check if your prior contractor period was certified for service credit. 3) HSA: if there were no wages for part of pay period, deferrals stop; we can run a pre-tax off-cycle to make up missed employee or employer HSA contributions but timing and tax impact matter.
nina (Benefits): adding vendor specifics: Vendor: REDWAY 401k (vendor code: RW-7102). HSA custodian: HealthSavings Trust (code: HST-3301). Off-cycle steps: People Ops opens Off-cycle Request ticket, include CompChangeForm, EmployeeDeferralReport, ManagerApproval. Vendor requires plan_code + payroll_journal id. Off-cycle window: allow 1-2 pay cycles for processing. For vesting credit: vendor needs signed service credit request form if contractor service is to be counted.
payroll-bot: auto-note: off-cycle file format example below. ensure employee_id matches HRIS_id.
```
EmployeeDeferralReport.csv
hris_id,pay_period_start,pay_period_end,employee_deferral,employer_match
M98765,2026-02-01,2026-02-14,0.00,0.00
M98765,2026-02-15,2026-02-28,150.00,37.50
```

sam (People Ops): mia  please upload CompChangeForm and the deferral report to the HR ticket and note whether you want us to request service-credit for prior contractor time. If manager approves, we can file the off-cycle for match or vesting.
lisa (manager): i approve both the off-cycle match request and the service-credit check for mia. thanks. :white_check_mark:
nina (Benefits): note on FSA: mid-year election changes for qualifying status (medical leave) are only allowed with a qualifying life event; unpaid leave alone doesn't automatically permit mid-year election changes. if you think you qualify, submit docs and we'll review.
mia (engineering): thanks all. i'll open the ticket with the forms and ping when uploaded. appreciate the clear steps. :pray:
